title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Luke 8: the parable of the sower, the storm on the lake, the man called Legion and Jairus' daughter.

questions.text: From whom does the text say seven demons had gone out?
questions.explanation: The text lists Mary who was called Magdalene as the one from whom seven demons had gone out.

answers.text: Susanna, one of the other women

questions.text: In the parable, what happened to the seed that fell along the road?
questions.explanation: The seed that fell along the road was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

answers.text: It withered because it had no moisture
The thorns grew up and choked it
It was trampled and the birds devoured it
It grew and bore fruit a hundredfold

questions.text: How much fruit did the seed that fell into the good ground produce?
questions.explanation: The seed that fell into the good ground grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.

questions.text: When he explained the parable, what did he say the seed is?
questions.explanation: He said that the seed is the word of God.

questions.text: What does he say a person does with a lamp once it is lit?
questions.explanation: No one covers a lit lamp with a container or puts it under a bed; it is put on a stand so that those who enter may see the light.

questions.text: Whom did he call his mother and his brothers?
questions.explanation: He answered that his mother and his brothers are those who hear the word of God and do it.

answers.text: The twelve who travel with him
Those who hear the word of God and do it
The women who served from their possessions
Those who came to him for healing

questions.text: What did he say to the disciples after he calmed the wind and the water?
questions.explanation: He rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and then asked the disciples, "Where is your faith?"

answers.text: "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"

questions.text: What name did the man with the demons give when Jesus asked his name?
questions.explanation: The man said his name was Legion, because many demons had entered into him.

questions.text: Who was Jairus, the man who fell down at Jesus' feet?
questions.explanation: The text says that Jairus was a ruler of the synagogue, and that he begged Jesus to come into his house.

questions.text: What did the woman with a flow of blood touch?
questions.explanation: She came up behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak, and immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

answers.text: His feet as he passed by
